sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Phase 3 is a full-service marketing agency, print production powerhouse, and branded merchandise company founded in 2001 in Atlanta, Georgia.

Industry: Marketing & Communications · HQ: Atlanta, Georgia · Size: <$50M · Products: Brand Strategy & Design, PR and Social Media, Media Planning & Management, Digital Printing & Marketing Fulfillment, Online Print Storefronts, Signage and Displays

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Phase 3 scores 28 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30) and event engagement (8/15). Nothing was found for application fit and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (34% similar on print, media, printing, life); Mactac (26% similar on print, media, signage, printing); ORAFOL Europe (5% similar on printing, digital, long-term, production). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
